purpose: Verify that an above-floor topology-passing fallback proceeds to normal executor and gate checks when every fresh-preflight feasible interface is already selected.

input.single_source_derivation: Exact candidate_sources[6] from the immutable development freeze.

candidate_contract.skip_expansion_only_if: The current raw plan selects every interface certified feasible by the fresh nuclei preflight.

failure_policy: Any mismatch, timeout, exception, incomplete receipt, or source identity failure is HOLD with no retry.
authorization_basis: Codex self-authorized one development counterexample after 42 focused tests passed and the saved receipt proved an above-floor topology-passing candidate was rejected solely by an impossible add-remaining-interfaces request.
